headline: Homeland Workers
title: Aniimo Homeland Workers Explained | Unlock Level and Abilities | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Homeland opens at character level twenty, once you finish the Wondrous R V quest. Sell your first wheat harvest at the Co-op Store to earn Home Coins, which pay for upgrades. Then put your Aniimo to work. There are thirteen worker abilities, nine elemental and four general, and each facility needs a specific one. Which facility are you building first? Comment below!
description: How Aniimo Homeland unlocks at level 20 and how its 13 worker abilities and Home Coins work.
